identityDecision: Use the standing listed Onsøy church from 1877 as the physical anchor and preserve the demolished medieval stone church as an earlier historical layer on the same church site.

historicalScope.source: Store norske leksikon; Norges Kirker; Den norske kirke
historicalScope.finding: The present church was designed by Henrik Thrap-Meyer and built in masonry in 1875–1877. It replaced a medieval stone church, historically also called Kolberg church, on the same site.

yearDecision.reason: The numeric year should identify the standing physical building. The medieval predecessor is preserved in the period, text and evidence rather than misdating the present church.
